description:
Set verifAIed up for a repository. **Free.** Call this first after
the verifAIed MCP is connected, and again after each step.

Pass the repository as ``owner/repo`` from the git remote (a repo UUID
also works) and the current git branch; the default branch is used
when ``branch`` is omitted.

Returns an ordered checklist. Each step has a ``status``:

  - ``done``: the server saw the result (a committed file, an
    analysis for the branch). No action.
  - ``todo``: required and not done. ``commands`` and ``files`` say
    exactly what to run and write.
  - ``check_locally``: required, but only your machine can tell (the
    CLI on PATH, the CLI's login). Run ``verify``; carry the step out
    if it fails.
  - ``recommended``: not required; verifAIed asks you to offer it to
    the user rather than skip it.
  - ``optional``: not required; mention it once.

``next_step`` names the step to do now and ``complete`` is true when
no required step is left. A step with ``needs_user`` true needs a
person — for ``cli_token``, to approve the ``verifaied login`` you run
in the browser. This tool never mints or returns a token.

This tool reads the repository through the GitHub App and never
changes it. You write the files; the user commits them. ``facts``
says what was read, and ``facts.github_reachable`` is false when the
tree could not be read, in which case every step the tree would have
settled is ``check_locally``.
name: setup
